title: No card overlaps the mark tile: a layout rule and a QC check
goal:
On the 3 Nov cut cards ran into the mark tile. The tile's box is boxFor('mark', aspect) (apps/renderer/src/engine/geometry.ts, HOUSE.mark.size 136 plus its 10 px shadow).

1. In layouts/index.ts, every slot box for every layout and aspect stays clear of the mark box plus its shadow plus 24 px; export a function markClearance(box, aspect) returning the overlap in px (0 when clear).
2. A unit test walks every layout's slots in both aspects and every FWP_PLACEMENTS entry and asserts markClearance is 0.
3. In scripts/velib/qc_composition.py add a row `mark_clearance` per beat: the beat's slot boxes (qc.inputs_from_props already resolves them) against the mark box read from the renderer geometry file (parse, never copy); fail on any overlap.

Tests: the layout walk; a synthetic beat whose slot overlaps the tile fails `mark_clearance`; the existing composition tests pass.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. The standard is docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md; every number below is measured there from Krish's inspiration-board reels.
